title: IMAGE/WIPEOUT clip-vertex cap fast slice
mode: Local implementation and focused generated validation
scope: Enforce the existing per-entity DXF clipping-vertex limit before vector growth
Keep shape validation consistent with the shared reader/writer cap
Add generated ASCII/Binary IMAGE and WIPEOUT controls for omitted group-91 counts

implementation.source: DRW_Image::parseCode now rejects group-14 growth at kMaxClipVertices before emplace_back; DRW_Image::hasValidClipBoundary rejects directly constructed over-limit paths.
implementation.compatibility: The parser's omitted-group-91 tolerance remains unchanged for paths within the implementation cap.
implementation.tests: The repeated-DXF hardening selector generates 100,001 group-14/24 vertices without group 91 for both IMAGE and WIPEOUT in ASCII and Binary DXF. Each route must fail with BAD_CODE_PARSED before its entity callback, retain the preceding LINE callback, and not publish the following LINE.
implementation.fixtures: No persistent DWG/DXF fixture was added; generated files are scoped to the existing temporary test directory and removed during cleanup.

assessment.commitLimitation: .git is read-only in the shared workspace; source, test, and plan edits remain uncommitted.

limitations: This closes only the local IMAGE/WIPEOUT per-entity storage-cap bypass. It does not establish validity of omitted group 91, all clipping semantics, DWG behavior, peer parity, or consumer support.
